annotations.title: Read a purchased Audit SEO Records report

description: Reads an Audit SEO Records report (or an Effect SEO Records monthly crawl) from the private link its buyer received (https://seorecords.com/audit?id=…): status and progress while the crawl runs; once finished, every signal found with its family, severity, number of pages and example URLs, the difference with the previous audit of the same site, and the yearly curve for Effect customers. Pages cited can then be fixed one by one with the SEO Records Corrector connector. Docs: https://seorecords.com/assistants

report.description: The report link (https://seorecords.com/audit?id=…) or its identifier
